factory_holds: Three coordinate-specific selected holes require resin fill, planarization, copper cap, and assembler acceptance; tenting is not a substitute.
C706 DNP ordinary bore/paste overlap must not survive into the populated assembly stencil; DNP is not a waiver for paste printing.
Package thermal-hole/paste interactions require their own explicit process review, not exemption as non-routed holes.
Excellon diameter does not establish drill tool, finished plating, bore fill, cap flatness or factory capability.
No native/CAM pass overrides unresolved transient, thermal, electrical, cell, fit or production acceptance.
